The clean you'll want to come home to every week

A standard clean is our core service: the rooms you live in most, cleaned properly. It's the right fit for homes that are already in decent shape and just need to be kept that way — and it's what we do on most recurring visits.

Booking is simple. Choose Regular Cleaning in our instant quote, tell us how your home looks right now (light, moderate or heavy), and you'll see your price before you book. Being honest about the condition helps us send the right amount of time and get it done right the first time.

"It's always a great feeling after she's done cleaning our living space to know that it's been thoroughly swept, wiped, dusted, and vacuumed to perfection. Highly recommend!" — Tom R., recurring client (Yelp review)

Your standard cleaning checklist

Kitchen

  • Countertops and backsplash wiped and sanitized
  • Sink scrubbed and faucet polished
  • Stovetop and appliance exteriors wiped
  • Microwave wiped inside and out
  • Cabinet fronts spot-cleaned
  • Trash emptied

Bathroom cleaning

  • Toilets, tubs and showers cleaned and sanitized
  • Sinks, counters and mirrors cleaned
  • Fixtures polished
  • Floors cleaned

Bedrooms and living areas

  • Reachable surfaces dusted
  • Mirrors and glass tables cleaned
  • Beds made (linens changed if fresh sheets are left out)
  • Light tidy of surfaces

Floors throughout

  • Carpets and rugs vacuumed
  • Hard floors vacuumed and mopped

Add-ons and upgrades

Want to go beyond the basics on this visit? Add inside the oven, inside the refrigerator, inside cabinets, interior windows or laundry right in the booking tool.

If it's been a few months since your last professional clean, a deep cleaning is usually the better first visit — it gets your home to a baseline that standard visits can keep up with.

Short on time? Ask about an express clean for quick touch-ups on floors, counters and major surfaces.

What's the difference between a standard and a deep clean?

A standard clean covers the essentials in every room. A deep clean adds detail work like baseboards, blinds, cabinet fronts, grout and the inside of the oven and fridge. If your home hasn't been professionally cleaned recently, start with a deep clean.

Will I get the same cleaner each time?

We work hard to send the same trusted person every visit. Consistency is better for the quality of the clean and for your peace of mind.

Can you use my products?

Yes. If you have favorite products or sensitivities, just leave them out and note it in your booking.

How do I pay?

You book online, and payment is collected after your clean is complete.
